response.sql: WITH units AS (SELECT s.sentreg, t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, s.instownpct AS ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE s.instownpct IS NOT NULL AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL), baselines AS (SELECT ownership, AVG(ownership) OVER (PARTITION BY order_type_mix) AS mix_baseline, AVG(ownership) OVER () AS overall_baseline FROM units) SELECT AVG(ownership) AS average_ownership, AVG(ownership / NULLIF(mix_baseline, 0)) AS average_ownership_to_mix_baseline, AVG(ownership - overall_baseline) AS average_excess_overall FROM baselines WHERE ownership > overall_baseline;
